static_traits.name: 罗杰
static_traits.social_status: 社交互动有限，因轮椅与自信not足而Withdrawal；有一位支持性的同事可倾诉
static_traits.medical_history: 几年前被诊断的医学状况导致需要依赖轮椅；除该状况外without其他显著身体疾病；此前not yet接受心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 坦诚、配合度较好；自我Reflection能力较强；情绪上有紧张但抱有希望

basic_info.main_problem: 尽管大量阅读，但我觉得自己not是一个好的读者，这让我感到痛苦和自卑。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not足感开始影响我的自尊与整体幸福感，并影响我在博物馆的工作表现。我想停止这种not够好的感觉，重新享受阅读而not再被负面想法困扰。
growth_experiences: 几年前被诊断的医学状况使我not得not依赖轮椅，身体活动受限。此后，阅读成为逃避与消遣的主要方式，但随着我越来越依赖阅读，我开始更频繁地将自己的阅读速度与他人比较，尤其在面对复杂文本时更易triggerSelf-doubt and inferiority。这段经历逐步加重了压力与Anxiety，影响了我的工作表现与社交互动（Reduced socializing、更多Self-doubt）。

special_situations.event: When discussing books with friends, comparing reading speed and comprehension expression
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的阅读速度和表达not如同伴，就说明I am not good enough、低人一等
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Signs up for speed-reading techniques and online courses, trying to prove herself and improve speed
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not会像他们那样好。

special_situations.event: Reading slows down and comprehension is strenuous with complex texts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能轻松应对复杂文本，就说明我not是一个好读者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tends to avoid challenging texts, reduces contact to lower frustration

special_situations.event: When the job requires extensive reading and explaining content to visitors
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在工作上理解/表达not够快，就证明我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Produces avoidance tendencies; reduces attempts at harder materials or tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管我怎么做，我都not会变好。

special_situations.event: After being restricted in activities by a medical condition, reading became the main pastime and self-consolation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 既然阅读是我主要的事情，我就应该读得更快、更好，否则就not合格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Putting pressure on oneself, continually practicing skills and harshly evaluating oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该读得更快，否则就说明I am not good enough。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as a capable, recognized reader and professional
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被比较后显得低人一等、被评价为not称职，从而Impaired self-esteem与被疏离
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being evaluated by avoiding challenging texts and social comparison
通过not断训练与理性解释来维持可控感与自尊

object_relations.object_representation: Friends are relaxed, more excellent others who may judge oneself

object_relations.self_representation: The explainer who is easily questioned at work
object_relations.object_representation: Visitors/others are strict evaluators who may pick out faults

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing books with friends, entering comparison situations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把他人视为更优秀的评判者，认为自己not配被认可
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 倾向use自贬语句，语气压低、避免主张观点，表达“我not如他们”。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others inquire about the causes of differences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: By emphasizing external factors such as practice and educational differences, pushes emotions to the background in order to gain a mental sense of control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopts an objective analytical tone, lists possible factors, reduces the expression of emotional vocabulary and subjective feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to directly face negative automatic thoughts and do cognitive restructuring
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 通过提前思考与准备not yet来的调整以减轻当前Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use前瞻性与计划性语言，设定小步目标，语气平稳且务实。

manifestations: Medical condition limits physical activity; needs to rely on a wheelchair
Treats reading as the main escape and pastime, feels one 'must' perform better at reading
outcomes: 自我价值与能力感受限

manifestations: 社交互动有限，因自信not足与轮椅use而Withdrawal
Mainly communicates with one supportive colleague; overall interpersonal support is lacking

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我比较与Self-denial（“我not如他们”）
面对复杂文本时过度关注not足与失败感

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Sets rigid 'should' standards for reading speed and comprehension (feeling one must be faster and better)
以他人表现为绝对参照，not yet根据自身情况调整标准

positive_force: Reads a lot; has the habit of sustained engagement
能进行自我Reflection并识do not压力与思维模式的影响
Positive attitude, willing to try change (willing to do restructuring and practice)
Has a supportive colleague at work to confide in
negative_force: 过度比较并negate积极面（心理过滤与negate正面）
Self-worth excessively bound to reading speed and performance
医学状况限制活动，带来持续性压力与Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids reading或回避挑战性（复杂）文本
antecedent: When comparing reading speed or discussing books with others
When needing to quickly understand and explain to visitors at work
target_behavior.core_reason: 将阅读速度与个人价值直接等同；在医学状况与压力背景下，对“慢”做负性归因并triggerSelf-doubt
target_behavior.function: 逃避被比较与被评价带来的Anxiety与羞耻感
target_behavior.consequence: 阅读体验进一步受损，能力提升受阻，Decline in work performance

antecedent: 在与朋友讨论书籍时感到not如人
自信not足与轮椅use带来的not适感
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被看作not称职、被比较后显得低人一等，因而Self-protection性Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: 避免外界负面评价与Impaired self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: 人际支持减少，Loneliness感与Self-doubt worsens
